replication_axis.rule: canonical Easy-14 order restricted to the eight held-out identities
replication_axis.reason: estimate order sensitivity before confounding it with cross-model transfer

runtime_qualification.warmup: one temperature-zero Reply OK. request capped at two tokens

primary_target.claim: baseline-conditional paired saving and outcome preservation under a second predeclared task order

qualification.status: predeclared task-order replication of the frozen held-out M2/P1 policy
qualification.pairing: cold exact-prefix FULL immediately before every candidate episode
qualification.missingness_rule: if exact-prefix FULL does not resolve, withhold the policy for that identity, carry the exact completed FULL episode into the continuous session, and continue to the next predeclared identity
qualification.interpretation: task identity is the statistical unit; report conditional preservation and unconditional session cost separately; compare against v3 only as an order-sensitivity replication

workspace_semantics.conversation: one continuous ordinary-role transcript without explicit task-boundary metadata
workspace_semantics.workspaces: clean official SWE-bench workspace per issue
workspace_semantics.guardrail: the policy receives no evaluator task ID, episode boundary, success flag, repository label, or workspace identity; genuine user prompts remain selected
